comment: Exchange values computed by xiangqi-server's xiangqi_server/api/util/exchange.py, run unmodified through a local pyffish shim. Upstream outputs, not human labels: if xq_classify.exchange disagrees, the two implementations have diverged. Moves are this project's 0-9 UCCI ranks; the server was given the same moves in its 1-10 ranks. No server source is included.
